checks.title: every summary score rate is recomputable from its own raw games
no summary reports a candidate with zero completed games
every raw game's job_id encodes its own candidate/opponent/seat
every candidate manifest carries deck, base-agent and wrapper hashes
no arm reports fewer raw games than it requested without saying so
no summary is older than the raw games it summarises
champion.json's per-opponent cells exist in the raw games it cites
error counts in summaries equal the raw non-completed rows
every package manifest carries an executed clean validation
every file and directory the contract names is present and non-empty
every evaluated candidate appears in CANDIDATE_HISTORY.jsonl

injections.injection: alter one score rate in a summary without touching the raw games
rewrite one raw record's candidate_id, leaving its job_id intact
delete deck_sha256 from a candidate manifest
delete raw rows for one candidate, leaving requested_games unchanged
backdate a summary behind its games.jsonl
alter a champion.json per-opponent score rate
zero the error count in a summary that has a failed game
remove one evaluated candidate from CANDIDATE_HISTORY.jsonl
